steps.name: StartupProbe — hard-gated Postgres and TLS verification before port binding
criteria: StartupProbe::run() issues SELECT 1 against the Postgres pool; when the pool cannot be acquired within 5 seconds the probe returns Err and main exits with code 1 without binding :9191
StartupProbe::run() opens a dedicated PgListener connection and round-trips a NOTIFY/LISTEN on a probe channel; failure returns Err and main exits with code 1

StartupProbe::run() validates the TLS certificate file: parses the PEM, checks that the common name matches the configured CN, and checks that the notAfter timestamp is at least 24 hours in the future; failure returns Err and main exits with code 1
main.rs calls StartupProbe::run() before server::run(); no gRPC listener is opened until all probe gates pass
Structured log line containing "connected to Postgres" appears before the line containing "listening on :9191" in the agent's log output
No substring of the EMBYR_AGENT_DB_DSN value appears in any log line at any level during or after the probe

#[ignore] removed from agent_logs_storage_readiness_before_accepting_connections, agent_exits_without_binding_port_when_storage_unreachable, and storage_credential_never_appears_in_agent_logs; all three pass

steps.name: GracefulShutdown + Ping RPC
criteria: SIGTERM received while a GetDocument RPC is in flight causes the agent to stop accepting new connections, allow the in-flight RPC to complete, then exit with code 0
Structured log line "shutdown complete" appears in agent output after SIGTERM-triggered shutdown
StorageAgentService::ping returns a PingResponse whose server_time field is a Timestamp within 2 seconds of the wall clock at call time
Ping RPC is declared in storage_agent.proto as Ping(PingRequest) returns (PingResponse) with server_time: google.protobuf.Timestamp
#[ignore] removed from agent_completes_in_flight_work_before_exiting_on_shutdown_signal; test passes

steps.name: Implement CreateDocument and UpdateDocument in StorageAgentService
criteria: StorageAgentService::create_document persists the document with generation 1 when the path does not already exist; subsequent GetDocument returns the stored fields
StorageAgentService::create_document returns Status::already_exists when the document path already exists; the existing document is unchanged
StorageAgentService::create_document when no document identifier is provided generates a 20-character identifier and returns it in the response
StorageAgentService::update_document with a field mask updates only the named fields; fields absent from the mask retain their pre-update values
StorageAgentService::update_document returns Status::not_found when the target document path does not exist; no document is created
StorageAgentService::update_document applies an increment field transform to an absent numeric field by treating the absent value as zero
When two concurrent update_document calls assert the same document generation, exactly one succeeds and the other receives Status::failed_precondition
Document generation increments by exactly 1 on each successful write; generations observed across three sequential writes are 1, 2, 3 in order

steps.name: Implement DeleteDocument in StorageAgentService
criteria: StorageAgentService::delete_document succeeds without error when the target document does not exist
StorageAgentService::delete_document for an existing document writes a deletion record to project storage; subsequent GetDocument returns Status::not_found

steps.name: Implement BeginTransaction, Commit, and Rollback in StorageAgentService
criteria: StorageAgentService::begin_transaction returns a transaction token; the token can be used in subsequent Commit or Rollback calls
StorageAgentService::commit with no concurrent competing transaction applies the buffered writes and advances document generation; subsequent GetDocument reflects the committed values
StorageAgentService::commit returns Status::aborted when a competing writer has already modified the document at the generation the transaction read
StorageAgentService::commit returns Status::aborted when a document read inside the transaction was deleted by another writer before the commit
StorageAgentService::commit returns Status::not_found when the transaction token does not exist (already committed, rolled back, or never created)
StorageAgentService::rollback discards all buffered writes; subsequent GetDocument shows the document unchanged at the pre-transaction generation
StorageAgentService::rollback returns Status::not_found when the transaction token has already been committed

steps.name: AgentTransactionSweeper — background expired-transaction cleanup
criteria: AgentTransactionSweeper runs as a tokio background task and executes a sweep every 30 seconds
Sweep operation deletes transaction records whose created_at timestamp plus TTL is earlier than the sweep execution time
A transaction record with an elapsed TTL is absent from the transactions table after the sweep runs; a transaction record whose TTL has not elapsed remains present
StorageAgentService::commit returns Status::not_found when called with the token of a transaction whose TTL has elapsed and which has been swept

#[ignore] removed from all 7 scenarios in us_a04_transactions.rs: transaction_with_no_competition_commits_successfully, rolling_back_transaction_discards_writes_without_applying_them, rolling_back_already_committed_transaction_returns_not_found, expired_transactions_are_removed_by_sweep, concurrent_transaction_on_same_generation_is_rejected_with_conflict, transaction_on_deleted_document_is_aborted_on_commit, committing_expired_transaction_returns_not_found; all pass

StorageAgentService::run_query returns Status::invalid_argument for a filter field path containing consecutive dots (e.g. "order..amount") without reading any documents from storage

steps.name: Subscribe proto extension + AgentNotifyBridge
criteria: storage_agent.proto declares Subscribe(SubscribeRequest) returns (stream DocChange) where SubscribeRequest carries a collection_path string and DocChange carries kind (upsert|delete), document_name, generation int64, and fields map
AgentNotifyBridge wraps a PostgresNotifyListener; it exposes a subscribe() method that returns a tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<DocChange> with channel capacity 64
AgentNotifyBridge::subscribe() translates each raw Postgres NOTIFY payload into a DocChange proto message with the correct kind, document_name, generation, and fields
When the internal mpsc channel is full (64 pending messages), AgentNotifyBridge sets an overflow indicator and the next DocChange delivered to all active receivers carries kind=reset to signal resync
cargo build --workspace succeeds after the proto extension; generated Rust bindings include SubscribeRequest, DocChange, and the Subscribe RPC client stub

steps.name: StorageAgentService::subscribe implementation + wire AgentNotifyBridge
criteria: StorageAgentService::subscribe opens a server-streaming response; after a write commits to the subscribed collection path the subscriber receives a DocChange event within 2 seconds
The DocChange event for a created or updated document carries kind=upsert, a generation value of at least 1, and the complete document fields with no truncation
The DocChange event for a deleted document carries kind=delete and the document_name of the removed document
When the AgentNotifyBridge mpsc channel overflows, all active Subscribe streams receive a DocChange with kind=reset before the next real change event
When a Subscribe stream is interrupted and the caller reconnects, writes committed after reconnection are delivered within 2 seconds
AgentNotifyBridge is constructed at composition root (main.rs) and injected into StorageAgentService via constructor; no AgentNotifyBridge is instantiated inside StorageAgentService
